vb_textbox.text: There are 2 pairs of gnomes - red & brown, purple & green. The max number of mushrooms is 9. Click randomly first to find which of each pair is performing best - it will stay that way for a few rounds then start decreasing. When it starts decreasing on average, swap to the other in the pair. Always remember to select something as 1.5 sec is not a lot of time. Don't be out off by random occurances of 0.
